The production board is showing a provisional run of up to 900 units on an eight-hour shift. Before I release the schedule, I need to check in with quality engineering and shift supervision as part of our normal pre-shift routine. Is there anything I should be aware of regarding Line 8, the standard work instructions, or any concerns about this run before we proceed?

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a critical issue. I received a customer deviation email on Thursday that limits this Sunday pilot run to exactly 480 units — not the 900 currently on the production board. Additionally, I should note that this deviation has not yet been attached to the production order, so we need to get that linked before anything proceeds.
